ProgramName: Bachelor of Arts in Art History
Description: The BA in Art History prepares students for careers as art professionals and for graduate study. It facilitates broad intellectual development, enabling students to cultivate essential career competencies in research, writing, critical analysis, persuasive communication, and interdisciplinary thinking. The Art History curriculum complements our BFA degree program and provides significant interaction between artists and art historians. [2] The Bachelor of Arts (BA) in Art History is designed to introduce methodologies for examining the interplay of art, culture, and politics spanning from ancient times to the present day. [2] The curriculum employs rigorous visual analysis, and engages in current scholarly discourse. [2] Students acquire a comprehensive understanding of art history through foundational courses, followed by specialized studies in areas such as early modern Europe, the history of photography, Latin America, and modern and contemporary art. [2] In addition to traditional European and American subjects from ancient to modern times, we offer a strong emphasis on Latin American art from Pre-Columbian to the present. [3, 4]

Description: Environmental engineers are the technical professionals who identify and design solutions for environmental problems affecting health issues and the quality of the air, water, and land. The impact of environmentalproblemsonthe qualityof lifehas a greatly expanded the job opportunities in environmental engineering, placing it among the fastest growing fields of the engineering professions. The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at FIU is the prime resource for environmental engineering education, training, research and technology development in South Florida. The technical interdisciplinary courses are in the areas of biology, geology, chemistry, ecology, atmospheric sciences, geotechnical engineering, urban planning, water resources engineering, pollution prevention, and waste management. The curriculum is designed to meet the State of Florida's articulation policy and to prepare graduates for professional engineering licensure.
